rows.evidence_summary: Pre-event annual and quarterly SEC filings show Madrigal's active development program centered on resmetirom and its Phase 3 MAESTRO studies. The earlier annual filing mentions MGL-3745 only as a potential backup compound to resmetirom, not as a separate meaningful active development program or clinical product candidate. SEC correspondence concerning the 2022 Form 10-K later explicitly confirmed that Madrigal had a single product candidate, resmetirom, and that all 2022 R&D costs related to resmetirom; that later correspondence is used only as corroboration of the contemporaneous pipeline evidence, not to infer a new pre-event fact.

promotion_boundary: Single-asset status alone does not establish final M7 eligibility. Historical universe, timestamp, financing, point-in-time evidence, concentration, eligible-registry and deterministic cohort-freeze checks remain mandatory.
